Name: Ballot_Drop_Boxes_2026_11_03

Display Field: status

Type: Feature Layer

Geometry Type: esriGeometryPoint

Description: Every active registered voter will receive a ballot in the mail nearly a month before Election Day. Voter's have the option to return their voted ballot to any of the Registrar’s official ballot drop boxes located around the county. The Registrar’s official ballot drop boxes are red, white and blue and feature the Registrar’s logo along with the County seal. All boxes are labeled “Official Ballot Drop Box” and made from high grade, heavy gauge stainless steel.
